title: Antibody - pollen allergen immunoprecipitation
projectDescription: Recombinant antibodies were used for immununoprecipitation with pollen extracts to define their specificity
sampleProcessingProtocol: The Pierce MS-Compatible Magnetic IP Protein A/G kit was used for immunoprecipitation of selected IgG antibodies with pollen extract from Phlenum pratense or Holcus lanatus overnight at 4 degrees Celcius. Proteins were eluted after washing and reduced, alkylated and subjected to in-solution digest with trypsin. BioPureSPN C18 spin columns were used for cleaning of the tryptic digest. Peptides were separated on a 15 cm, 75 µM ID SelfPack column with emitter tip and frit using an EASY nLC 1200 system connected online to a QExactive HF-X mass spectrometer operating in positive ion mode with DDA.
dataProcessingProtocol: The raw MS data files were processed using MaxQuant version 1.6.17.0 with the following databases: all UniProt Phlenum Pratense proteins as of 20220602, the antibody sequences and all timothy-derived sequences from allergen.org as of 20220602.
